notes.subject: אם לא
notes.rationale: 'Ee, ka nnete' — Seheberu se bolela 'ge e se gore ga se bjalo', kanegelo ya go tiša, e sego potšišo.

notes.subject: נפשי
notes.rationale: Moya — nefesh ke 'bophelo/breathing', e sego 'moya' ka mafelelo ka moka; Sepedi ga e na lentšu le tee le swanago.

notes.subject: עלי נפשי
notes.rationale: Sepetlele sa go boela: 'ke moya wa ka' kgahlanong le 'go nna' goba 'ka nnete' — Šeuol ya mabapi le go fetoga ga go swana ga gomul gabedi.

notes.subject: כגמל... כגמל
notes.rationale: Go busediwa ga gagalo-morago gabedi go dira kagare; Sepedi e boloka go busediwa gabedi.

translation: Ee, ke beile moya wa ka o didimetse, bjalo ka ngwana yo a robetšwego thologo go mmagwe; bjalo ka ngwana yo a robetšwego thologo ke moya wa ka.
